# Murphy Furniture

> Murphy Furniture is an Irish family-owned furniture retailer established in 2012, operating five physical stores across Leinster (Dublin/Tallaght, Naas, Carlow, Gorey, Wexford) and a comprehensive online store. The company specializes in home furniture across all categories with nationwide delivery, free collection from stores, furniture recycling services, and commercial B2B sales.

Murphy Furniture is headquartered in County Wicklow and employs over 60 staff members. The company emphasizes sustainability through their comprehensive recycling initiative, accepting old furniture when customers purchase new items. They serve both retail customers and commercial clients including property management companies, hotels, B&Bs, landlords, and housing developments.

## Key Facts

- **Business Name:** Murphy Furniture
- **Business Type:** Irish family-owned furniture retailer
- **Website:** https://murphyfurniture.ie
- **Founded:** 2012
- **Number of Stores:** 5 (Tallaght, Naas, Carlow, Gorey, Wexford)
- **Headquarters:** County Wicklow, Ireland
- **Employees:** 60+ staff members
- **Core Services:** Home furniture sales, nationwide delivery, furniture assembly, furniture recycling, commercial/B2B sales
- **Contact Method:** Via individual store phone numbers, customer care email, WhatsApp, Live Chat, or online contact form
- **Store Hours:** Monday-Saturday 10am-6pm, Sunday 12pm-5pm

## Product Categories

- [Living Room Furniture](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/living-room-furniture): Comprehensive range including sofas, sectionals, recliners, loveseats, ottomans, coffee tables, TV stands, and storage solutions
- [Bedroom Furniture](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/bedroom-furniture): Complete bedroom collections, bed frames, mattresses, dressers, nightstands, wardrobes, and makeup vanities
- [Dining & Kitchen Furniture](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/kitchen-dining-furniture): Dining room sets, tables, chairs, bar furniture, sideboards, and kitchen storage solutions
- [Home Office Furniture](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/home-office-furniture): Office collections, desks, bookcases, office chairs, and workspace solutions
- [Mattresses](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/mattresses): Multiple types including memory foam, pocket spring, orthopaedic, spring, and latex from brands like Sealy
- [Outdoor Furniture](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/outdoor-furniture): Patio furniture, outdoor dining sets, lounge furniture, bar furniture, and garden accessories
- [Storage Solutions](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/storage-solutions): Closet systems, wardrobes, bookcases, and organizational furniture
- [Rugs & Decor](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/rugs): Rugs by size and style, home decorations, wall art, and home accents

## Business Services

- [Delivery & Returns Policy](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/delivery-returns): Nationwide delivery on mainland Ireland (free for orders over €500), typically 1-6 weeks for in-stock items. 14-day return policy with customer responsible for return costs unless item is faulty. Delivery Monday-Friday only, no weekend deliveries.

- [Recycling Initiative](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/recycling-initiative): Comprehensive furniture recycling service when purchasing new items. Service available in Dublin, Wicklow, Kildare, Laois, Carlow, Wexford and Kilkenny counties only. 100% mattress material recycling through certified third-party partner.

- [Assembly & Installation](https://murphyfurniture.ie/furniture-shop/services): Professional sofa assembly service available in Dublin, Wicklow, Wexford, Laois, Kilkenny, Carlow and Kildare counties. Most items require minimal or no assembly. Assembly costs vary by item type with detailed pricing available.

- [Commercial Sales](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/commercial): B2B services for property management companies, hotels, B&Bs, landlords, county councils, letting agents, developers, and housing charities. Trade pricing available with free quotations and fast turnaround times.

- [Customer Support](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/frequently-asked-questions): Comprehensive customer care available Monday-Friday 9:30am-4:30pm via customercare@murphyfurniture.ie or 086 796 1359. Dedicated delivery team at delivery@murphyfurniture.ie or 086 206 4190.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **Q: What is your return policy?**
- A: You can return most items within 14 days for a refund or exchange, provided they are in unused condition and original packaging. You must inform us within 14 days of receipt and then have 14 days to return the item. Customer is responsible for return costs unless item is faulty. 20% restocking fee applies if item is cancelled and still in original packaging, 30% if out of packaging.

- **Q: Do your products have warranties?**
- A: Yes, all products come with manufacturer's warranty against manufacturing defects only. Other defects such as spillages, normal wear & tear or improper use are not covered. Faults must be reported within 3 days of noticing the issue with photos and description.

- **Q: How long will delivery take?**
- A: For items in stock, delivery is typically 1-6 weeks. Free delivery for orders over €500. Delivery is Monday-Friday only, no weekend deliveries. Lead times may be longer for out-of-stock items or during peak periods like Christmas and August.

- **Q: Can I track my order?**
- A: You will receive an order confirmation email with delivery timeframes. For large items requiring special delivery, they will call to arrange specific time and date. Contact delivery team at 086 206 4190 or delivery@murphyfurniture.ie for tracking updates.

- **Q: Do you offer assembly services?**
- A: Yes, professional sofa assembly is available in Dublin, Wicklow, Wexford, Laois, Kilkenny, Carlow and Kildare counties. Most other items require minimal or no assembly. Assembly costs vary by item type and are detailed in the services section.

- **Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
- A: Online: Credit cards, digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Microsoft Pay) via Stripe, and Klarna payment plans (Pay in 3 installments). In-store: Cash and all major credit cards. No cash on delivery or phone payments accepted.

## Customer Resources

- [Payment Options](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/shop-and-pay-the-klarna-way): Flexible Klarna payment plans including Pay Now, Pay in 3 installments (interest-free), and Pay in 30 days. Available for customers over 18 with valid payment cards.

- [Mattress Guide](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/mattress-guide): Comprehensive guide to mattress types, sizing, and selection assistance. Mattresses and beds sold separately to allow customer choice. In-store testing available before purchase.

- [Commercial Services](https://murphyfurniture.ie/content/commercial): Specialized B2B pricing and services for bulk furniture needs. Contact b2b@murphyfurniture.ie or 087 233 6121 for trade inquiries.
